content.user_title: Build Azure Key Vault Key Workflows in Rust
content.value_statement: Rust teams need clear patterns for Azure Key Vault key operations. This skill provides SDK examples for setup, authentication, lifecycle tasks, crypto use, and RBAC planning.
actual_capabilities: Shows the Rust crates needed for Azure Key Vault Keys SDK usage.
Demonstrates KeyClient setup with Azure Identity credentials and a vault URL.
Provides examples for getting, creating, deleting, listing, backing up, and restoring keys.
Summarizes RSA, EC, RSA-HSM, and EC-HSM key type choices.
Identifies Key Vault RBAC roles for crypto users and key administrators.
limitations: Does not provide a complete production Rust application.
Does not cover every SDK method, error path, or retry setting.
Requires an Azure subscription, a Key Vault, and suitable permissions.
Uses placeholder names and URLs that must be replaced before use.

use_cases.title: Prototype Key Management
use_cases.description: Build a Rust proof of concept for creating, retrieving, and listing Key Vault keys.

use_cases.title: Plan Secure Cloud Access
use_cases.description: Map authentication choices and RBAC roles before connecting services to Key Vault.

use_cases.title: Review Cryptographic Workflows
use_cases.description: Compare key types and lifecycle operations for services that encrypt, sign, or wrap data.

prompt_templates.title: Set Up Dependencies
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me add Azure Key Vault Keys support to a Rust project and configure the vault URL placeholder.

prompt_templates.title: Create and Retrieve Keys
prompt_templates.prompt: Show guidance for creating an RSA key, retrieving it, and listing key properties with the Rust SDK.

prompt_templates.title: Choose Authentication
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare DeveloperToolsCredential and ManagedIdentityCredential for local and production Rust services using Key Vault keys.

prompt_templates.title: Design Production Key Lifecycle
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a Rust service workflow for key creation, rotation, backup, restore, RBAC roles, and safe handling of backup data.

output_examples.input: A developer asks how to start using Key Vault Keys from Rust.
output_examples.output: The skill returns setup steps, required crates, credential guidance, and a simple client initialization path.

output_examples.input: A team needs to decide between RSA and EC keys.
output_examples.output: The skill summarizes supported key families and explains when each type fits encryption, signing, or HSM-backed requirements.

output_examples.input: An operator needs roles for a service that signs data.
output_examples.output: The skill points to Key Vault Crypto User for cryptographic use and Crypto Officer for broader key administration.

best_practices: Use managed identity for production workloads instead of local developer credentials.
Protect backup data and restrict who can restore keys.
Enable soft delete and plan key rotation before production use.
anti_patterns: Do not hardcode real vault names, tenant IDs, or secrets in source files.
Do not print or store key backup material in logs or shared locations.
Do not grant full key administration roles to services that only need crypto operations.

faq.question: Does this skill manage Azure Key Vault secrets?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on Key Vault keys and cryptographic key operations, not secret storage APIs.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code compatible workflows.

faq.question: Does it create real Azure resources automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides examples and guidance. Users must run commands and configure Azure resources themselves.

faq.question: What authentication method does it show?
faq.answer: It shows DeveloperToolsCredential for development and recommends managed identity for production services.

faq.question: Does it explain HSM-backed keys?
faq.answer: Yes. It identifies RSA-HSM and EC-HSM key types as hardware-protected options.

faq.question: What permissions are mentioned?
faq.answer: It mentions Key Vault Crypto User for crypto operations and Key Vault Crypto Officer for full key CRUD access.
